rows.comparison_as_reported: Y238X variant present (homozygous or heterozygous) vs absent (homozygous WT); HSCT recipients with IA vs control recipients
rows.verbatim_source: HSCT recipients with IA vs control recipients 13/71 12/108 1.79 (.77–4.19) .17
rows.note: Carriers 13/71 cases, 12/108 controls; text states 'All these individuals were heterozygous'. Non-carrier counts not printed separately (would be 58 and 96 by subtraction from n/N; left null). Univariate OR, Pearson chi-square P.

rows.comparison_as_reported: Y238X polymorphism possession vs absence; HSCT recipients with IA vs control recipients
rows.verbatim_source: After multivariate adjustment for neutropenia and graft-versus-host disease, the adjusted OR was 1.70 (95% CI, .72–4.00; P = .22).
rows.note: Adjusted for neutropenia and GVHD. Same counts as crude analysis.

rows.comparison_as_reported: Y238X variant present vs absent; HSCT donors to recipients with IA vs control donors
rows.verbatim_source: HSCT donors to recipients with IA vs control donors 10/68 17/107 0.91 (.39–2.13) .83
rows.note: Carriers 10/68 vs 17/107; DNA unavailable for donors of 3 IA cases and 1 control. Heterozygosity of donors inferred from Table 2b footnote (all individuals heterozygous except one non-HSCT patient). Non-carrier counts left null.

rows.comparison_as_reported: Presence of Y238X in both HSCT recipient & donor vs not; IA cases vs controls
rows.verbatim_source: Presence of Y238X in both HSCT recipient & donor 5/68 8/107 .98 (.27–2.80) .98
rows.note: Pairs with both carriers: 5/68 IA cases vs 8/107 controls. Pair-level, not genotype counts; left counts null.

rows.comparison_as_reported: Y238X allele frequency, non-HSCT patients with IA (19.0%) vs HSCT patients with and without IA (7.0%)
rows.subgroup: Non-HSCT patients with IA vs HSCT recipients (with and without IA)
rows.verbatim_source: The allele frequency of the Y238X SNP was significantly elevated in the non-HSCT patients with IA (19.0%), compared with HSCT recipients (7.0%; P = .01)
rows.note: Non-HSCT IA: 7/21 carriers, 1 homozygous (heterozygous count not printed separately). Comparator 25/179 carriers, all heterozygous per Table 2b footnote; comparator includes 71 HSCT IA cases. Fisher's exact test.

rows.comparison_as_reported: Y238X allele frequency, non-HSCT patients with IA (19.0%) vs healthy HSCT donors (7.7%)
rows.subgroup: Non-HSCT patients with IA vs healthy HSCT donors
rows.note: Non-HSCT IA: 7/21 carriers, 1 homozygous. Healthy donors 27/175 carriers, all heterozygous per footnote. Controls are healthy, not at-risk patients.

rows.comparison_as_reported: Y238X allele frequency, non-HSCT patients with IA (19.0%) vs Dutch healthy population (6.9%)
rows.subgroup: Non-HSCT patients with IA vs Dutch healthy population [ref 6]
rows.note: External healthy population (19/138 carriers, heterozygous per Table 2b footnote) from previous study. Non-HSCT IA: 7/21 carriers, 1 homozygous.

paper_note: Chai 2011 JID: Dectin-1 (CLEC7A) Y238X carrier analysis in 71 HSCT IA cases vs 108 HSCT controls (crude and adjusted ORs, recipient/donor/both) plus allele-frequency comparisons for 21 non-HSCT IA patients; Kaplan-Meier time-to-IA and survival analyses among IA cases (P=.94/.88, .83/.99) not extracted as they are not susceptibility comparisons.
